Outfit: navy crew-neck knit sweater with a white t-shirt collar showing, beige straight chino trousers, white leather sneakers. Not a model, not an idol; natural, slightly asymmetric face, real skin texture. Framing reference: recreate the framing of @image5 exactly: two-shot in a bright cafe by a window, round marble table; the woman sits on the left leaning toward the man with her right hand near her chin, the man sits on the right holding up a white smartphone in his right hand, its back toward the camera; both look at his phone; iced americano left, iced latte right.
One continuous shot. A friend at the next table films on a smartphone held vertically, eye level, 50mm look; light natural handheld sway of 2 to 4 cm, no zoom, no pan. Modern phone video, clean natural colors, no over-sharpening, no film grain.
0.0s to 1.2s: a soft chime; both keep their eyes on his phone. He says his short line flatly without looking up. 1.2s to 3.0s: she leans a little closer to the screen, her eyes widen and she says her line, caught off guard, her hand dropping from her chin; he stays still. 3.0s to 5.0s: dead silence, both frozen staring at the phone, mouths slightly open; she blinks once.
Both faces must match the reference images exactly through the whole take; same hair, glasses and clothes. Eyes steady, natural blinks only, no look at the camera. Only one phone in frame. No subtitles, no on-screen text. Absolutely no music.
The man says in Korean, low and flat: "또 들어왔어." Then the woman says in Korean with a soft Vietnamese accent, surprised: "…어? 우리 엄마~" Then two seconds of silence. Natural delivery, visible lip-sync.
